appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Follow the system, or pick a theme explicitly

service.title: Service Management
service.installed: The service was installed and started.
service.routeThroughHint: Runs the proxy in the installed service instead of inside the app
service.hintElevation: Installing or removing the service asks for administrator approval (UAC / sudo)
service.hintAutostart: The service starts automatically at system boot
service.hintProduction: Service mode is recommended for production

config.noNodesHint: Nodes come from an invite. Import one to start routing domains.
config.multipleNodesHint: Multiple nodes are supported; the same domain can be configured on several nodes for load balancing
config.overviewHint: Shows the unique domains configured across all nodes, {count} in total
config.strategyRoundRobinDesc: Distribute requests to each node in turn

settings.tunDeviceNameHint: Virtual network interface name (auto-assigned on macOS; ignored there)
settings.relayModeHint: Configure the iroh relay forwarding mode
settings.relayUrlHint: Required, and used on its own — no N0 relay. Applies on the next start.
settings.relayAuthTokenHint: Only if the relay requires one. The server needs the same token.
settings.launchAtStartupHint: Automatically run the proxy when the app launches
settings.minimizeOnCloseHint: Minimize to the system tray when the close button is clicked
settings.logLevelHint: Controls the verbosity of log output

invite.title: Add a node from an invite
invite.description: Paste a nexapipe:// link: the output of the server's --generate-invite command, or one that was shared with you.
invite.name: Name
invite.relayHint: Applies to every node, not just this one
invite.applyRelay: Also use it as this machine's relay
invite.twoFactorHint: Fills in the client ID and secret for this endpoint only
invite.enrollmentHint: A one-time token: the server issues this endpoint's credentials when it first connects, and the token stops working
invite.alreadyPresent: Already in the list — importing merges its domains into that node.
invite.added: Added the node from the invite.
invite.merged: Merged the invite into the existing node.
invite.enrolled: Enrolled as {client} and saved the credentials it was issued.

node.connectionHint: Nodes come from invites, so the target cannot be changed here.
node.twoFactorHint: Must match this server's [auth.clients] entry. Leave it off for a server that has no 2FA.
node.enrollmentPending: Waiting to enroll as {id}: the server issues this node's credentials on the next connect.
